search_window.basis: Authenticated GitHub predecessor readback; recall window starts at its 08:48:14.980 PST completion. OCHA OPT and WHO checked first, then exactly 12 targeted searches. One AP photo-caption identification detail was recovered for the previously recorded three-death Gaza City airstrike; date of article publication and when the caption first appeared not independently verified, so recorded as newly recovered follow-up, not proven in-hour publication.

findings.title: AP photo captions identify three men mourned after Gaza City airstrike
findings.location: Gaza City, Gaza Strip (joint funeral); Tel al-Hawa vehicle strike discussed in same article but identities not explicitly linked to vehicle occupants
findings.affected_population_system: AP photographs identify Khaled Naem, Mustafa Refa’i, and Ahmad al-Sawafiri as three men mourned at a joint funeral after they were killed in an Israeli airstrike. The same report describes a three-fatality food-carrying vehicle strike in Tel al-Hawa. The photo caption does not itself explicitly state that these were occupants of that specific vehicle. No additional fatalities counted.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Mourners grieve over the bodies of Khaled Naem, Mustafa Refa’i and Ahmad al-Sawafiri, who were killed in an Israeli airstrike
findings.source_type: Established international wire agency; original on-scene photographs and captions credited to AP photographer Yousef Al Zanoun

bounded_discovery_context.publication_time_basis: AP article and photographs identify events as Saturday 21 November 2026, but no independently verified publication/last-update timestamp; this is a newly recovered detail, not confirmed in-hour publication.
bounded_discovery_context.prior_overlap: Three deaths in Tel al-Hawa food vehicle strike already recorded and subsequent food distribution/WCK affiliation follow-ups recorded; prior watch heartbeats did not name these three men. Do not count three additional deaths.

bounded_discovery_context.caveats: Caption verifies names and Gaza City funeral, but not definitively the exact Tel al-Hawa vehicle occupants, civilian/militant status, or death time. No independent second-source identity corroboration. AP separately quotes Shifa Hospital director confirming three deaths, but does not explicitly connect named mourners to the truck.
